dedupe_keys.name: watersheds and infrastructure providing food energy and water to us cities

description: Watersheds and Infrastructure Providing Food, Energy, and Water to US Cities is a data set listed in HydroShare, an online repository for hydrology data and models, published or maintained by Ao, Yufei Zoe (deposited on HydroShare). Civil infrastructure underpins urban receipts of food, energy, and water (FEW) produced in distant watersheds. In this study, we map flows of FEW goods from watersheds of the contiguous United States to major population centers and highlight the critical infrastructure that supports FEW flows. Coverage: United States. The resource was created 2024-02-28 and last updated 2024-05-01; HydroShare lists it as a composite resource. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the HydroShare metadata only, so the files and any paper they support were not opened, their current availability was not checked, and the abstract may lag the deposit. It can support infrastructure planning, operations and risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-hydroshare-infrastructure-resources.
